title: SocialPost
description: Native payload of the social channel. What the HappyRobot social-ingest workflow receives: an unverified public post, exactly as a firehose would deliver it. No claims, no trust, no resolved zone: the ingest workflow decides whether the post is signal or noise, extracts claims, and resolves location from the text.

id.description: Post id (sig-* id of the underlying signal, for extraction scoring).

author.description: Handle of the poster (generated in simulation). Unverified identity.

text.description: The post content, raw. Location, if any, is inside the text.
